BL-1885 — A hotfix commit can duplicate a build already in flight (2026-10-02: BL-1877 was hotfixed while the coder's own build sat unclaimed in QA's queue): the commit-msg chain now refuses a hotfix whose stamp-off ticket has a live parcel in any mailbox or an unlanded build on a role branch, unless the message names that build as superseded
